description.value: Viet House is a Vietnamese restaurant on Cambie Street serving both traditional dishes and chef-crafted fusion plates, including elevated specials like duck confit, seafood in coconut broth, and duck coconut curry. The restaurant offers a full bar with cocktails, local beers, and wine alongside classic pho and banh mi sandwiches. Located on a key Vancouver cycling corridor, it provides indoor seating and a broad menu suited to a range of dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: hoop at 16m; heart (2 spaces) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 34m; rack at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 38m; hoop (4 spaces) at 50m; hoop at 54m; stands (2 spaces) at 65m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active Vietnamese restaurant at 3420 Cambie Street, Vancouver. The menu explicitly lists multiple vegetarian and gluten-free items. Website contact page shows two different postal codes for the same address: V5P3J8 (header block) and V5Z 2W8 (footer block). Address postal code is uncertain.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Viet House is a legitimate, active restaurant on Cambie Street (a major Vancouver cycling route) with good vegetarian and GF options. However, no evidence confirms bike parking, washroom access, or water refill — the three required WWC criteria — so a brief on-site check or outreach to the business is needed before inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes dedicated vegetarian section with items such as lemongrass tofu sub, crispy tofu bowl, vegetarian pho, tofu coconut curry, and vegetarian fried rice/noodle. Multiple items (grilled skewers, calamari, crispy chicken wings) are explicitly labelled gluten free
